steps.action: Stay in lane 3. Accelerate up to about 9 to 10 m/s only until you are about 5 to 6 m ahead of the VUT. Do not pull farther than about 6 m ahead. Do not change lanes yet.
steps.termination_condition: You are about 5 to 6 m ahead of the VUT (not more than about 6 m) and still in lane 3.
steps.reason: Catch up for a close cut-in without opening a huge gap (station within 10 m).

steps.action: Immediately merge left into the center lane while about 5 to 6 m ahead of the VUT. Do not accelerate to open more gap.
steps.termination_condition: You are in the center lane and about 5 to 6 m ahead of the VUT.
steps.reason: Lane-change into the ego lane while still ahead (tight cut-in).

steps.action: After cutting in, drive at a nominal cruise about 7 to 9 m/s in the center lane (near the VUT's speed). Do not slow to a crawl. Do not change lanes.
steps.reason: Post-merge nominal speed — not abandoned or crawling.
